zapwebp.convertOnSave.description: Automatically write a .webp file when you save a .svg.

zapwebp.baseWidth.description: Base width for @1x output (used by multi-scale command).

zapwebp.clean.description: Strip EXIF, XMP, and C2PA metadata on conversion.

zapwebp.outputExtension.description: Target format for the single-file command.

zapwebp.defaultTargets.description: Default recommended target formats per source file type.

zapwebp.showMultipliersForPng.description: Offer retina @1x, @2x, @3x multi-scale outputs for PNG sources.

zapwebp.rememberLastChoice.description: Remember the last-used target format per source format and promote it in the QuickPick menu.
